title: msdes
text: Data loaded function [rrmsdessetup()] , data self contained within function. user option change inputs.
code: rrmsdessetup(  # change model settings or assumptions used in scenario analyses   drc= 0.035, #3.5% discount rate for costs   drq= 0.035, #3.5% discount rate for qalys   time_horizon = 70, # number of years model is running for starting at intial age   p_eid=0.6, # proportion of patients on external interval dosing   jcvtest_cost= 0 #assumed free due to home service, test cost could be £247 privately but not offered in the NHS   )

title: simple
text: Treatment names, treatment lines, MS severity states DES key events specified.
code: ## Treatments at second line  v_treatment_names <- c("Natalizumab-IV",                        "Natalizumab-SC",                        "Natalizumab biosimilar-IV",                        "Natalizumab biosimilar-SC",                        "Cladribine",                         "Ublituximab" ,                        "Ofatumumab",                        "Ocrelizumab")  ## number of treatments n_treatments <- length(v_treatment_names)  ## specify codes for the treatments v_treatment_codes <- c(seq(1, n_treatments)) names(v_treatment_codes) <- v_treatment_names  ## Treatments that patients can move to at 3rd and higher line  v_higher_line_treatments <- c("Natalizumab-IV",                               "Natalizumab-SC",                               "Natalizumab biosimilar-IV",                               "Natalizumab biosimilar-SC",                               "Cladribine",                               "Ublituximab",                               "Ofatumumab",                               "Ocrelizumab"                               ) v_higher_line_treatment_codes <- c(seq(1, length(v_higher_line_treatments))) names(v_higher_line_treatment_codes) <- v_higher_line_treatments  ## prior treatment index v_prior_treatment_indices <- c(rep(0, length(v_higher_line_treatments))) names(v_prior_treatment_indices) <- v_higher_line_treatments  ## Model event states v_event_names <- c("initialise","age" , "relapse", "edss_increase", "edss_decrease", "progression", "treatment_switch", "annual_treatment", "serious_adverse_event", "death"                    )  ## Define the possible EDSS values v_edss_values <- c(0:9) names(v_edss_values) <- paste("EDSS", v_edss_values)  # Number of EDSS categories n_edss_values <- length(v_edss_values)

code: ## set a seed  n_seed<-243523452 set.seed(n_seed)  ## number of patients and samples n_patients <- 10 n_samples <- 10   # Run the simulation environment(run_sim_new) <- asNamespace("WARDEN")   total_runtime <- system.time({   results <- run_sim_new(       npats = n_patients,      n_sim = n_samples,        # number of simulations to run     psa_bool = TRUE,            # use PSA or not. If n_sim > 1 and psa_bool = FALSE, then difference in outcomes is due to sampling (number of pats simulated)       debug = FALSE,     sensitivity_bool= FALSE,                  # sensitivity analysis not implemented,     arm_list = v_treatment_names,             # intervention list     common_all_inputs = common_all_inputs,    # inputs common that do not change within a simulation     #common_pt_inputs = common_pt_inputs,     # inputs that change within a simulation but are not affected by the intervention     unique_pt_inputs = unique_pt_inputs,      # inputs that change within a simulation between interventions     init_event_list = init_event_list,        # initial event list     evt_react_list = evt_react_list,          # reaction of events     util_ongoing_list = util_ongoing,         # ongoing rrms or spms disease utilities     cost_ongoing_list = cost_ongoing,         # ongoing rrms or spms disease costs     util_instant_list = util_instant,     cost_instant_list = cost_instant,         # instantaneous treatment costs     input_out=c("age", "sex", "spms_flag", "edss_value", "n_relapse", "n_sae_evts", "n_edssinc_evts", "n_edssdec_evts", "current_treatment_code", "treatment_line", "n_switch", "years_on_treatment", "treatment_stop",                  "t_2ndline", "t_3rdline", "t_4thline", "waning"), #
